Definition: akin to G3509; gloom (as of a storm):--blackness.
BiblicalUsage: gnóphos is the word for blackness. In Hebrews 12:18, the text says "nor unto blackness."
TheologicalSignificance: For me, gnóphos means blackness, and I leave it at that.
